title: Stochastic Non-Linear Influence in Synchronisation Dynamics
summary: We propose a mathematical model that represents the influence of an external actor (influencer) on a network of actors (influenced). The model is an adaptation of control systems within the family of formulations inspired by the Kuramoto Model of synchronisation. Capturing influence as a capacity to affect the character or behaviour of another, we study an external node's ability to influence the synchronisation of the Kuramoto system while its global behaviour is pulled to the external node's frequency and away from its natural mean frequency.
